[CR CR0894r4 for 38.306] Reason for change: For NTN, the referencing of TS 38.101-5 is missing for some band and power related parameters. Summary of change: Add the referencing of TS 38.101-5 to indicate to which spec the parameter shall refer for NTN. Impact Analysis Impacted 5G architecture options: NR SA Impacted functionality: Frequcny and power related parameters. Inter-operability: 1. If the network is implemented according to the CR and the UE is not, UE may use the wrong value. 2. If the UE is implemented according to the CR and the network is not, the network may use the wrong value. Consequences if not approved: UE and Network may use the wrong value.

[CR CR5082r2 for 38.331] Reason for change: Correction of miscellaneous non-controversial errors (typos etc). Summary of change: In SIB2, need code for t-ReselectionNR-SF is changed from Need N (“Upon receiving message with the field absent, the UE takes no action”) to Need S. UE behaviour upon absence of the field is captured in field description with reference to TS 38.304 (no multiplication of TreselectionNR with scaling factor will take place).
